points.description: States that the compiler replaces/expands the inline function call with the function's code (the function body is substituted at the call site). Equivalent wording such as 'inline expansion' or 'code is pasted in place of the call' earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: Award 1.5 if the student only says the function is treated specially/inlined, or that the call is avoided, without clearly saying the code is inserted at the call.

points.description: States that this happens at every place/each point where the function is called (a separate copy of the code for each call).
points.partial_credit: Award 1 if the student implies copies are made but does not make clear it applies to every call site (e.g. says 'a copy is made' only once).
